query:
SELECT 
  p.id as package_id, 
  p.packageType, 
  p.totalHours, 
  p.usedHours,
  p.deductedMinutes,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attendanceType = 'normal' THEN a.durationMinutes ELSE 0 END), 0) as real_used_minutes,
  p.totalHours - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.attendanceType = 'normal' THEN a.durationMinutes ELSE 0 END), 0) as real_remaining
FROM packages p
LEFT JOIN attendances a ON a.packageId = p.id
WHERE p.residentId = 60001
GROUP BY p.id, p.packageType, p.totalHours, p.usedHours, p.deductedMinutes
ORDER BY p.id;
